subtitle: The Altars Series, part 3
preacher_note: Guest minister. Third in the series for her — she also preached 26 July and 2 August. Auto-transcript renders her name "Shodiko"; the repo spelling Sodipo is correct.
note: Source clips were 1920x1080 Zoom-room exports, not vertical. Each was cropped below the burned-in Zoom name label, reframed to 9:16, upscaled and graded with the Film Look LUT before the usual finish: voice lifted from about -37 LUFS to -14, music bed underneath, three-card animated closing, then the two ALTARS end-card screens. The Romans 8 clip needed an animated crop because the room camera drifts right throughout.
voice_note: Dr Titi Sodipo teaches rather than exhorts. She reaches for physics and household examples, hedges honestly when she is unsure of a reference, and corrects a misconception without scolding whoever holds it. Captions should sound like someone reporting what they heard, not like the church selling it.

posts.title: The charge against you was nailed there
posts.quote: He cancelled the record of charges against us and took it away, nailing it to the cross. In this way He disarmed the spiritual rulers and authorities.
posts.onscreen: "You keep a list of everything you've done wrong." → "Someone already dealt with it."
posts.endline: You are bracing for a fight with an enemy who is armed. → He was disarmed at the cross. → The charge against you was nailed there too.

captions.instagram:
Most of us keep a private list. Everything we have done that we would not want read out.

The verse she read on Sunday says that list was cancelled. Not overlooked. Not filed away in case it is needed later. Taken and nailed to the cross.

And the thing that was holding it over you had its weapons taken off it at the same time.

You do not have to have your life sorted before any of that applies to you. That is rather the point of it.

If you are in Manchester and you want somewhere to think about this without being put on the spot, we gather Sundays at 10:30am on Carmoor Road. Come as you are, sit at the back, nobody will make a fuss of you.

🎬 From "Altars and the Believer's Victory" — Dr Titi Sodipo. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

Save this for the next time the list starts reading itself out. 💛

posts.title: Faith is not denial
posts.quote: Faith does not deny the reality of what can be seen. That is not faith. That is denial.

captions.instagram:
If you have ever been told that having faith means pretending the problem is not there, this one is for you.

She is a physicist, so she reached for a jumbo jet. 570 tonnes. Gravity pulling down on it with over five million Newtons of force. That force is real, it is measurable, and it never switches off.

The plane flies anyway. Not because gravity stopped, but because something stronger is acting on it.

Which means you are allowed to say the hard thing out loud. The diagnosis is real. The letter is real. Nothing has changed yet. Saying so is not a failure of faith.

Swipe through if you have been carrying that particular guilt.

🎬 From "Altars and the Believer's Victory" — Dr Titi Sodipo. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Overwhelming victory — Romans 8:36-37
posts.quote: For your sake we are killed every day, we are being slaughtered like sheep. Despite all these things, overwhelming victory is ours through Christ Jesus.
posts.onscreen: "The verse doesn't pretend it's easy." → "Read what comes after 'despite'."
posts.endline: For your sake we are slaughtered like sheep. → Despite all these things — → overwhelming victory is ours through Christ Jesus.

captions.instagram:
What I like about this verse is that it does not skip the hard part.

It says outright: for Your sake we are killed every day, we are being slaughtered like sheep. It names the relentlessness before it says anything hopeful. No pretending, no rushing past it.

And then the word that turns it. Despite.

Despite all these things, overwhelming victory is ours through Christ Jesus.

Not instead of the hard things. Not once they are over. Despite them, while they are still going on.

🎬 From "Altars and the Believer's Victory" — Dr Titi Sodipo. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

Send this to whoever is having the year that will not let up.

posts.title: Make allowance
posts.quote: Whenever I think somebody has done something to hurt me, I remind myself: let me make allowance. Let me make maybe.

captions.instagram:
She has a habit for the person who annoyed you and does not know it.

When she thinks someone has hurt her, she stops and starts making excuses for them. Maybe they forgot. Maybe something happened at home. Maybe.

Maybe is the whole thing. She is not deciding they are innocent. She is refusing to decide they are guilty.

And she is honest about why she does it. It is not really about them. It is about what she has to carry around all week.

One person, this week. The one you are still a bit annoyed with. You do not have to tell them anything.

🎬 From "Altars and the Believer's Victory" — Dr Titi Sodipo. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

posts.title: Fight from the victory, not for it
posts.care: 83 seconds. Fits Facebook Reels' 90 second cap, but only just — post it there before anything gets re-trimmed. No cap issue on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.
posts.quote: It is not that we are going to start fighting a new battle. We are fighting from a standpoint of victory. What we are doing is to enforce that victory. We are enforcers.
posts.onscreen: "You're fighting like it could still go either way." → "It can't."
posts.endline: You fight like the outcome is still in doubt. → It was settled at the cross. → Fight from the victory, not for it.

captions.instagram:
There is a difference between fighting for a result and fighting from one, and most of us have never been told which one we are doing.

She put it plainly on Sunday. You are not starting a new battle. The outcome was settled a long time before you turned up to it. What is left is holding the ground that was already taken.

That changes how tired you are allowed to be. You are not carrying the weight of whether this works out.

🎬 From "Altars and the Believer's Victory" — Dr Titi Sodipo. Full sermon on YouTube (search Calvary Hephzibah).

Comment with the thing you have been fighting for that you could start fighting from.

posts.title: The flu testimony — not clipped
posts.care: HELD BACK, and not cut. Dr Titi Sodipo tells a healing story that resolves: she resisted the illness, slept, woke up healed. It lands well in the room. As a stranger-facing Reel it reads as "resist hard enough and the illness lifts", which wounds anyone still ill. The attract audience includes people who have prayed exactly that prayer and are still sick. If it is wanted, route it to Stories or the members feed, not the public grid. Bolaji's call.
posts.quote: Whatsoever you do not resist, you are permitting.
